title: Quenched Australian Anchovy Stew
description: A comforting Australian-inspired dish featuring the brininess of anchovies, slow-cooked to create a rich and velvety texture.

ingredients.name: Red wine
ingredients.notes: Dry red wine for depth of flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced carrots and diced potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Add the anchovy fillets to the stew and simmer, uncovered, for another 10 minutes, until the anchovies have broken down and the stew has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
